name: open-read-only-checkpoint-retry-bound
body: The read-only open retries a concurrent writer's checkpoint recovery for at most about five seconds (25 ms steps) and matches only the documented lbug recovery wordings (checkpoint recovery is pending, and the WAL shadow/checkpoint messages). A real recovery on a very large graph, or a differently-worded recovery error, surfaces the last error rather than retrying further. Raise the bound or widen the predicate if a legitimate recovery is observed to exceed it.
